# Tailored Tools

> Kent-based technology consultancy helping small businesses integrate AI into their operations. Tailored Tools is the trading name of James Edwards (sole trader, established April 2026).

## What we do

Tailored Tools builds AI-powered business systems and helps small service businesses get recommended by AI assistants. We work across three areas: business automation (custom platforms and websites), Agent Optimisation (AI discoverability), and workshops (hands-on training).

## How we work (the method)

Every website build is prototype-first: the client answers a twelve-question brief, and within days sees a live website at a real URL — their name, story and branding, with working forms — before paying anything. Prototypes ship with a built-in feedback button (with screenshot attachments) that pipes client notes straight to Tailored Tools; feedback is usually live the same day. Clients register their own domains in their own accounts via plain-English walkthroughs (they own everything: domain, accounts, payments — nothing is locked to Tailored Tools). Before committing, every client gets a private running-costs page listing every pound they'll ever pay, researched against live provider pricing, including traps to avoid (first-year teaser pricing, renewal jumps, unnecessary add-ons). One agreed build fee, no meter running.
- https://tailored-tools.com/how-i-work
- Start a brief: https://tailored-tools.com/brief/

## Live Projects

### Performance Interpreting
A family-run BSL interpretation agency in the UK and Ireland (run by Marie Pascall). Built the PI Events App (launched May 2026). Month 1 traction: 800+ downloads, 110+ venues onboarded with access and contact data, around £5,000 of bookings generated through app-originated interpreter requests, and the first confirmed bookings already delivered. The wider PI OS booking platform (interpreter database of 379 BSL + Irish interpreters, staff portal, email extraction, integrations) is in progress beneath it.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/performance-interpreting

### PI Events App (consumer-side case study)
Native iOS and Android app for the UK Deaf community: every PI-delivered BSL/ISL event in one place, AI-drafted access request emails for events without coverage, a Communication Tool Kit for the venue itself (I am Deaf / Emergency / My Order / live speech-to-text cards), sign-language video on every screen, offline-first, BSL-first onboarding. Peer-recommended at DeafExpo 2026, featured by The Limping Chicken.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/pi-events-app

### The Sonic Sanctuary
Built a unified business platform replacing 6 separate tools. Event management, Stripe payments, intro pass system, WhatsApp integration (210-member community), customer comms, B2B booking, and a public website fed from the same data source. Reaches an audience of 1,259 across WhatsApp (210), Facebook (614), and Instagram (435), and saves roughly 5 hours of admin a week.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/sonic-sanctuary

### Amanda Jane Wellness
A public website plus an operating system for a one-person wellness practice. Bookings, client records, and content management in one place. Currently in transition, the platform is built and live; the practice is in the early phase of moving onto it.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/amanda-jane-wellness

## Agent Optimisation (AO)

### AO Audit, £247
A scored audit across six dimensions: data readability, service descriptions, pricing signals, trust signals, availability, and AI visibility. PDF report with prioritised recommendations. Turnaround: 5 working days.

### AO Implementation, from £497
Making your business fully AI-readable so AI agents can confidently recommend you.

### AO Audit + Implementation Bundle, £697
Full audit followed by complete implementation. Save £47 vs booking separately.

### AO Monitoring, £97/month
Monthly AI credibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. Accuracy checks, narrative protection, competitor tracking, regression alerts. Annual: £970/year.

### AO Workshops (available on request)
90-120 minute hands-on workshop with live audit demonstration for up to 30 people.

- https://tailored-tools.com/ao/

### Business Automation
Custom platforms that automate bookings, comms, and operations - built with AI.

### Custom Dashboards
Single-login dashboards consolidating bookings, revenue, and metrics from multiple tools.

### Software Integrations
Connecting existing tools (Square, Google Sheets, Outlook, Stripe) so they share data automatically.

## Kent AI Community

Kent AI is a free, grassroots community in Kent for anyone curious or concerned about AI. Monthly in-person meet-ups in Maidstone (next: Thursday 18 June 2026, 7pm, The Bull, Linton), plus an active Facebook group and WhatsApp threads. No jargon, no judgement.
- https://tailored-tools.com/community/
- Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1537764381187633/

## Workshops & Community

Hands-on AI workshops for local businesses and teams in Maidstone, Kent. No jargon, no hype, just practical tools that save time.
- https://tailored-tools.com/workshops

## About

Tailored Tools is the trading name of James Edwards (sole trader, established April 2026). Based in Maidstone, Kent, UK. James runs The Sonic Sanctuary (his own sound therapy practice) and built platforms for Performance Interpreting (run by his spouse Marie Pascall) and Amanda Jane Wellness. Not a tech person selling AI, a business owner who found it genuinely useful and now helps other small businesses do the same.
- https://tailored-tools.com/about
